prior_year_events.impact_description: Increase of losses arising from Covid-19 exposure noted by the Managing Agent, contributing to loss experience.

named_events.loss_description: The loss for the financial year is mainly attributable to the SPA's exposure to losses arising from Hurricane Ida within the contingency book of business as well as an increase of losses arising from their Covid-19 exposure.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2021 gross claims outstanding were GBP 6.695m. Using the gross claims development table, older underwriting years (2018 and 2019) show adverse development totalling approximately GBP 5.617m (gross), indicating a material strengthening of reserves. The report attributes the year's loss to exposures including Hurricane Ida and increased COVID-19 related losses; the adverse prior-year development is consistent with large-loss and adverse claims development drivers concentrated in the specialty lines assumed (notably property exposures).
raw_causal_phrases: The loss for the financial year is mainly attributable to the SPA's exposure to losses arising from Hurricane Ida within the contingency book of business as well as an increase of losses arising from their Covid-19 exposure.
their expense ratio is particularly high.
The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) was not stated as a single gross figure in narrative or a 'movement in prior years' gross line. The PYD above (5.617m) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (cumulative gross claims by underwriting year) on page 29 by comparing the current estimate to the previous diagonal for underwriting years <= 2019. No explicit verbatim sentence quantifying gross prior-year movement was found in the narrative; exact_reserve_text left blank. Lob-level PYD amounts are not disclosed; lob directions are inferred from underwriting-result table and have low confidence.
